zh-Hans: 现在轮胎还有余力。上吧，把这场较量结束掉！
en: The tires have still got grip. Let's go. Time to finish this battle!
No choice. Time to use that.
Guess I'll have to do it.

zh-Hans: 他技术很好，但不是超不过去。
en: He's good, but he's not impossible to pass.
I'll catch him!
That car's fast. I can't stay with him!
I've got to find an opening!

zh-Hans: 我不会放弃。有空当，就一定冲过去！
en: I won't give up. If there's an opening, I'll take it!

zh-Hans: 差距没缩小，但也没被甩开。
en: I'm not gaining, but he's not pulling away either.

zh-Hans: 他能过去，我就没道理过不去！
en: If he can make it through, there's no reason I can't!

zh-Hans: 一米两米也好，能缩短多少就缩短多少！
en: A meter, two meters, anything. I've got to close this gap!

zh-Hans: 也许还有机会，现在放弃还太早！
en: There might still be a chance. It's too soon to give up!

zh-Hans: 不是错觉，他的入弯突然变慢了！
en: I'm not imagining it. His corner entry has suddenly slowed!
Damn it! I'm not letting him pull away!

zh-Hans: 非要做到这一步吗？既然你打定主意……
en: You're taking it that far? If that's how you want it...
Amazing... He's good...
Ugh, he's fast!
I blew it!
Damn, he's fast!
Fast!
What was that?!
He passed me? You can do that?
Damn it! Not here!
That corner entry really is incredible...
Fast... He really is fast...
Amazing.
Ugh!
Ugh!
Tch!
Whoa!

zh-Hans: 一分神，不是撞上山壁，就是掉进谷底。
en: If I lose focus, it's the cliff face or the bottom of the ravine.

zh-Hans: 这股感觉越来越强，有什么要来了！
en: I can feel it tingling through me. Something's coming!
He won't drop back. He's right on me!

zh-Hans: 背后的压力强得像针扎一样！
en: The pressure from behind is so strong it hurts!

zh-Hans: 稍微松口气，就真的危险了。
en: Even a moment's lapse could be really bad.

zh-Hans: 后面撑不住了，后轮的抓地果然开始掉了。
en: The rear isn't holding. The rear tires really are losing grip.
Excuse me. Coming through.

zh-Hans: 控制得住，能按自己的节奏跑。好，这样也许能行！
en: I can control it. I can drive my own way. Good. This might work!
Good. This might work!
I'm not losing. I'm faster!
All right, right here!
Go!
Yeah!
Come on, go!

zh-Hans: 过弯时尽量少打方向，反而更快吗？
en: Is it faster to turn with as little steering as possible?

zh-Hans: 为什么呢？感觉特别顺，速度一下就上来了。
en: Why is that? It feels so good, and the speed just builds.
I'm not in the mood to give way.
